rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone cannot do something.

example.english: I’m sick today and unable to go to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2 m4 dak1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this construction when the sentence specifies the particular action someone is unable to accomplish.

example.english: I’m unable to find your phone.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 nei5 bou6 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this when the inability comes from not knowing how to do something.

example.english: I’m unable to make this dish.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 sik1 zing2 ni1 go3 coi3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that there is no way for the person to manage or solve the situation.

example.english: The document is due tonight, and I’m really unable to finish it.
example.traditional: 個文件今晚要交，我真係冇辦法整完。
example.jyutping: go3 man4 gin6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 gaau1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3 zing2 jyun4
